newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was moderate throughout the day Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $1.00 lower than late last week.

Inquiry was good, demand was fair. Sales confirmed on 30,400 slaughter steers and 21,400 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 57,500 head confirmed including 12,900 head or about 22 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1075-1275 lbs 66.00; few select with end choice 1050-1225 lbs 65.50.

Heifers - select and choice 2-3 990-1200 lbs 66.00; few select with end choice 65.50; few mixed commercial to choice heifers and heiferettes 1050-1125 lbs 64.50-65.00, pen including cows 1250 lbs 64.00.
